risks: Decision ID UBU-D0359 cannot be confirmed as the next unused ID from the DECISIONS.md hunk context; a collision would require renumbering across all three files.

New normative text cites §§21.1.4–21.1.5 for stop-to-quiescence and resource-release ceilings and relies on an existing `InteractionBudgetV1.audio_endpoint` ref/version field; neither is visible in the prompt, so dangling references are possible.

The enforceability bar (disable speech acquisition if silent microphone fallback cannot be prevented; withhold speech output if queued audio cannot be kept off unreviewed sinks) may make audio unavailable on common mobile/car platforms where OS-controlled routing cannot be pinned, which could narrow the MVP voice surface in practice.

Route qualification and peripheral/Device trust overlap thematically with the hardware questions UBU-Q0164–UBU-Q0182; the proposal does not cross-reference them, risking split ownership of accessory qualification.
The DESIGN.md addition is a single dense block of many stacked requirements, which is harder to audit and test-map than the table-plus-fixtures style used by UBU-D0322.
The Resolution paragraph is rewritten as one long line, raising merge-conflict risk with any concurrent proposal touching the same question.
required_fixes: Verify UBU-D0359 is the next unused decision number before merge; renumber consistently in DECISIONS.md, DESIGN.md and OPEN_QUESTIONS.md if not.

Verify that §§21.1.4–21.1.5 exist and define the quiescence/resource-release ceilings referenced, and that `InteractionBudgetV1.audio_endpoint` exists as a ref/version field; adjust the references if either is absent.
scores.rationale: Patch applies cleanly, passes allowlist and question-schema checks, and keeps UBU-Q0128 Open with its metadata line untouched. It answers a real open slice (subquestion 17: headsets, car audio, phones/watches, handoff) in the same decision-per-slice pattern as UBU-D0309–D0333, adds no schema changes, no new actions, no MVP commitment and no new questions. The DESIGN.md text is coherent with the existing controller-boundary and playback-referent sections and includes explicit negative qualification cases. Deductions are for unverifiable cross-references (decision ID, §21.1.4–21.1.5, audio_endpoint field), the density of the normative block, lack of cross-reference to the hardware question range, and the practical risk that the fallback-prevention bar leaves audio unavailable on common platforms.

selection_rationale: Only one candidate was submitted and it passed all mechanical checks. It is a valid, bounded, directly responsive partial answer to UBU-Q0128 subquestion 17 that preserves the question schema and existing v1 audio schemas; remaining items are verification fixes rather than defects in the design content.
